dedupe_keys.name: ptsnet parallel transient water network model

description: PTSNet is a Python package from its University of Texas at Austin developers for transient simulation of pressurized water networks. It uses a vectorized and distributed method of characteristics to study rapid hydraulic changes. The repository supplies a worked valve-closure example using a network INP file, simulation workspace and selected operation times. Users can inspect time-series heads at named junctions and reuse the accompanying publication notebooks for further scenarios and analysis. Spatial coverage, network discretization and duration depend on the supplied network and simulation settings. Source and installation instructions are public and free under the Unlicense. These tools support examination of operational transients and water-network failure conditions. A limitation is that the documented parallel workflow needs Linux or macOS and OpenMPI; Windows users can run the sequential version. Existing model-epanet is the network-input and initial-state modelling dependency identified by the article. The package was not installed or benchmarked during this review.
